limitations: This fictional manifest defines evaluation facts and is not evidence of a live product or a rendered screenshot.
Interaction execution must be evaluated separately from visible state correctness.

brief.productIntent: Help an account owner review identity, security, and notification settings without losing confidence about what will be saved.
userJobs: Change one setting and understand whether it saved
Correct a validation error without losing entered values
protectedCapabilities: Security settings remain visually distinct from notification preferences
contentTruth: A mobile validation error belongs only to the phone field

typographyRoles: Compact sans-serif labels with restrained weight
A calm medium-weight page title rather than an oversized marketing headline
colorRoles: Ink blue for primary text and actions
Brick red only for errors and destructive consequences
spacingAndShape: Borders carry structure more often than shadows
componentPosture: Sections use headings and dividers instead of a card for every field
imageryRole: No decorative hero imagery on settings surfaces
motionTone: Brief functional feedback with no theatrical transition

avoid: Hiding the save action on mobile
Turning verified status into unsupported marketing copy
